history.comment:
There's Greek land here, but it's just the southermost small unnamed tip of Katonisi (=Kato Nisi), a small, rocky uninhabited islet located just off the coast of the deserted island of Antipsara.

It's also a Special Protection Area (Birds Directive).

https://datazone.birdlife.org/site/factsheet/1151

Greek land here (the Kalogeroi islets), although almost impossible to conquer. Theoretically, a massive private yacht with a seasoned open-sea crew could drop anchor in the vicinity under perfect weather conditions. It's not restricted or protected area.
